end.summary:
Practised showing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi answered 14 as 1 ten and 4 ones with prompting.
They identified 7 ones in 17 and 1 ten in 17.
One unaided correct response was recorded; teach-back was not passed.
Lesson ended when Saanvi asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making a number with one bundle of ten and loose ones. Using the tens digit as one bundle and the ones digit as loose sticks helped them explain 14 and identify parts of 17. They first mixed up the ones count for 14, then corrected it later in the lesson. At home, make bundles of 10 straws and ask Saanvi to build 11–20, saying the ten and ones aloud.
